_comment: Facts the content and outreach agents may use. Anything starting with NEED must be filled in by a person; agents never invent it.
one_liner: NEED: one sentence on what the business does and for whom
audience: NEED: who the content is for
proof_points: NEED: real customer count, testimonial or result. Leave the list empty if none.
offer: NEED: e.g. free trial, free consultation, discount
cta: NEED: e.g. 'DM START' or link in bio

voice.tone: NEED: 1-2 sentences on how the brand sounds
